D.treatment: reported knowing well what AI is
D.comparison: did not know what AI is

cells.quote: "approximately one-third of respondents (33.9%) indicated they did not know what artificial intelligence is, while 24.0% reported knowing well what AI is, and 42.0% indicated they roughly imagine what it is."
cells.note: The study text reports descriptive percentages from a secondary analysis of a national survey; it does not report an inferential test or manipulated treatment.
